author: (J.Agardh) Kylin, 1932

note.en: A soft, slippery, branching red seaweed. Known from herbarium specimens from Punta Cahuita (1972) and Portete near Limón.
note.es: Un alga roja blanda, resbalosa y ramificada. Se conoce por especímenes de herbario de Punta Cahuita (1972) y Portete, cerca de Limón.

evidence: GBIF: 2 herbarium specimen records in the region

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón
